title: 応用化学統合演習
subtitle: Interdisciplinary Studies of Applied Chemistry
keywords: Inorganic Chemistry 2.Materials Chemistry 3.Organic Chemistry 4.Biological Chemistry 5.Environmental Chemistry
educationalGoal: In this course, you will gain the ability to solve practical problems based on chemistry and engineering, which will help you in your future activities.
advice: This course will provide integrated scientific and practical skills through general exercises as well as lectures, with the goal of helping your future career development.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge gained in all previous chemistry and engineering classes will be useful in this class.

activityGoals.body: Able to think logically based on the fundamental principles of science.
Able to explain the role chemistry and related fields can play in modern society.
Able to explain the roles of engineers and researchers in chemical industries and related fields.
Able to communicate developments and advancements in chemistry to others.
Able to choose the best career for you.
Able to plan your future career development.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
